# SteamServer.net
> Community-run Counter-Strike 2 and legacy Counter-Strike server network with game servers, player stats, rankings, and support resources.

SteamServer.net provides public game servers and related community services, including server listings, player statistics, rankings, bans, and support information for players using its Counter-Strike infrastructure.

## Main Site
- [Home](https://steamserver.net/): Main landing page for the SteamServer.net gaming network and community services.
- [Servers](https://steamserver.net/servers): Browse available game servers, player counts, maps, and connection details.
- [Stats](https://steamserver.net/stats): Access player statistics, rankings, and gameplay performance across supported servers.
- [Bans](https://steamserver.net/bans): Review ban records and moderation actions across the server network.
- [Support](https://steamserver.net/support): Find help resources and contact options for server or account issues.

## Game Servers
- [CS2 Servers](https://steamserver.net/servers/cs2): List Counter-Strike 2 servers with status, maps, and player activity.
- [CS:GO Servers](https://steamserver.net/servers/csgo): Browse legacy Counter-Strike: Global Offensive server listings and details.
- [CS 1.6 Servers](https://steamserver.net/servers/cs16): View Counter-Strike 1.6 servers, player counts, and connection information.
- [Server Details](https://steamserver.net/servers/view): Inspect individual server information, map rotation, and live player status.

## Player Statistics
- [Player Rankings](https://steamserver.net/stats/rankings): View leaderboard positions and compare top players across the network.
- [Player Search](https://steamserver.net/stats/search): Search for player profiles, statistics, and historical performance data.
- [Player Profile](https://steamserver.net/stats/player): Access individual player stats, achievements, and match-related records.
- [Weapon Stats](https://steamserver.net/stats/weapons): Explore weapon usage, accuracy, and kill statistics by players.
- [Map Stats](https://steamserver.net/stats/maps): Review map-specific performance trends and gameplay statistics.

## Moderation
- [Ban List](https://steamserver.net/bans/list): Browse active and historical bans issued on SteamServer.net servers.
- [Ban Search](https://steamserver.net/bans/search): Search moderation records by player, Steam ID, or other identifiers.
- [Submit Appeal](https://steamserver.net/bans/appeal): Request review of a ban or moderation action.
- [Admin Actions](https://steamserver.net/bans/admins): View moderation activity and administrative enforcement records.

## Community
- [Forum](https://steamserver.net/forum): Participate in community discussions, announcements, and support conversations.
- [Discord](https://steamserver.net/discord): Join the community Discord server for chat, support, and announcements.
- [Rules](https://steamserver.net/rules): Read server rules, conduct expectations, and enforcement policies.
- [Announcements](https://steamserver.net/news): Follow updates about servers, events, and community changes.

## Account and Access
- [Login](https://steamserver.net/login): Sign in to access account-specific features and community services.
- [Register](https://steamserver.net/register): Create an account for stats tracking, support, and community participation.
- [Profile](https://steamserver.net/profile): Manage account details, linked identities, and personal settings.
- [Steam Sign-In](https://steamserver.net/auth/steam): Authenticate using a linked Steam account.

## Help and Support
- [Support Center](https://steamserver.net/support): Get help with gameplay, bans, account access, and technical issues.
- [Contact](https://steamserver.net/contact): Reach the SteamServer.net team for general inquiries and assistance.
- [FAQ](https://steamserver.net/faq): Find answers to common questions about servers, stats, and moderation.
- [Report Issue](https://steamserver.net/support/report): Submit technical problems or server-related issue reports.

## Policies
- [Terms of Service](https://steamserver.net/terms): Review terms governing use of the SteamServer.net platform and services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://steamserver.net/privacy): Understand how user data is collected, stored, and processed.
- [Cookie Policy](https://steamserver.net/cookies): Learn about cookie usage and related tracking preferences.
- [Legal Notice](https://steamserver.net/legal): Access legal and compliance information for the site.
